Melaksanakan kegiatan operasional gudang sehari-hari, termasuk penerimaan, penyimpanan, pengambilan, pengemasan, dan pengiriman barang. Menangani material, produk, dan inventaris secara akurat dan aman. Mematuhi SOP gudang serta standar keselamatan, kualitas, dan kebersihan lingkungan kerja. Mengoperasikan peralatan dan sistem dasar gudang sesuai kebutuhan. Mendukung akurasi inventaris melalui pelabelan yang tepat dan pencatatan pergerakan stok. Membantu pelaksanaan penghitungan stok dan pemeriksaan inventaris. Melaporkan kendala operasional, kerusakan barang, atau masalah keselamatan kepada atasan. Mendukung pencapaian target produktivitas dan inisiatif perbaikan berkelanjutan.

JAPFA is an agribusiness company that engages mainly in the production of animal feed, poultry breeding, commercial farm, consumer products, aquaculture, and beef cattle farming. Founded in Indonesia and now headquartered in Singapore, we employ over 37,000 people across an integrated network of modern farming, processing and distribution facilities in Indonesia, Vietnam, India, Myanmar, and Bangladesh. We believe our people are the key to staying ahead, and we continuously seek talented individuals to grow with us and contribute to our mission.
